---
title: "Install R and the packages you need"
---

You have used R before. Check that your installation is recent and has the packages below.

## 1. R and an editor

Install a recent [R](https://cran.r-project.org/) (4.3 or newer) and [RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/), or another editor you like.

## 2. Packages

```r
install.packages("tidyverse")   # dplyr, ggplot2, readr, stringr, tidyr, purrr
```

That is all the core material needs. Any data an exercise uses can be downloaded from that exercise's page.

## 3. Check it works

```r
library(tidyverse)
crosses <- sample(c("A", "a"), 1000, replace = TRUE)
table(crosses)
```

If that prints two counts close to 500 without an error, you are ready.
